verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document AI-drafted job descriptions, outreach sequences, or rejection notes, and nothing covers tone matching. The closest items describe other features: AI-generated careers pages built from the company website, AI-suggested interview questions, AI applicant scoring, and manual email via the sourcing extension. None of these covers drafting recruiting copy for a role, so none earns credit here.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
